title: Refactor incidents.py - extract nested models
description: incidents.py is 1095 lines with many nested Pydantic models. Consider extracting related models into separate files (e.g., vessel.py, crew.py, event.py) for better organization.

title: API does not handle invalid ObjectId format gracefully
description: When passing an invalid ObjectId format to /api/incidents/{id}, the API raises an unhandled ValidationError instead of returning a proper 404 or 422 response. The API should catch this validation error and return an appropriate HTTP error response.

title: Set up pytest test suite
description: Create pytest structure with conftest.py, unit tests for models, integration tests for API endpoints
close_reason: Pytest test suite fully set up with 23 unit tests for models and 19 integration tests for API endpoints. All tests pass (41 passed, 1 skipped). Tests cover Pydantic models, Beanie Document models, API CRUD operations, pagination, filtering, and validation.

title: Refactor routes.py - split into separate route modules
description: routes.py is 982 lines and handles all API endpoints. Should be split into separate modules by resource type (incidents, sources, overviews, logs, tasks) for better maintainability.

title: Model field names mismatch in tests
description: Tests used assumed field names that don't match actual models. Key fixes needed: EventData.resolution is required, VesselData uses vesselFlag/vesselUniqueID, IllegalFishingClassification uses IUUSubType/IUUTypeReason, IndustryOverviewExtract uses species/countries/companies/incidents/summary
close_reason: Fixed all model field name mismatches in tests. Correct field names: vesselFlag (not flagState), vesselUniqueID (not vesselIMO), resolution (required on EventData), IUUSubType + IUUTypeReason (required on IllegalFishingClassification), speciesInvolved + productsInvolved + description (required on ExtractedIncidentData).

title: Add test dependencies to requirements.txt
description: Test suite requires additional dependencies not in requirements.txt: pytest, pytest-asyncio, httpx. Consider creating a requirements-dev.txt or adding a [test] extras section.

title: Fix Beanie model unit tests
description: Unit tests for Beanie Document models need database initialization AND ExtractedIncidentData has required fields: speciesInvolved (List[Species]), productsInvolved (List[ProductData]), description (str). Need to update tests to provide these required fields.
close_reason: Fixed all model tests with correct field names: vesselFlag (not flagState), resolution (required on EventData), IUUSubType + IUUTypeReason (required on IllegalFishingClassification), speciesInvolved + productsInvolved + description (required on ExtractedIncidentData). All 23 tests pass.
